verdict:
**Not CLEAN — one real defect found.**

### 1. Overlapping / clipped UI — YES, at the modal's bottom edge
- The **"Lighting: Sun" control row** on the canvas is half-covered by the Design Templates modal: a text fragment "**…ing: Sun**" (top of "Light" sheared off) and a strip of **stray swatch squares** poke out below/beside the **Close** button (~x 455–685, y 740–755). It reads as a rendering glitch, not intentional occlusion.
- The floating **"Analyze" button is sliced in half** by the modal's right edge (only "…alyze" side shows at ~x 970, y 710), and the **Innovate button** peeks out next to it.
- Root cause: the **modal has no dimmed/backdrop overlay** — the canvas behind is at full brightness, so anything colliding with the modal edges (Analyze, Lighting row) looks broken instead of deliberately covered.
- Minor: the **Close** button appears to straddle the modal's bottom border slightly.

### 2. 5-second comprehension — Mostly yes
"Design Templates / Start from a pre-made design. This will replace your current design" plus six clearly named, described, and tagged cards (Popular, Events, Real Estate…) communicates the choice quickly. The good "will replace your design" warning is present. The broken bottom edge and half-visible buttons are the main distraction.

### 3. Other confusing / broken-looking items
- **"FPS: 3"** in the status bar is a raw debug metric — it looks alarming/broken to a normal user; consider hiding it or only showing it in a dev mode.
- The modal's only exit is the low-contrast gray **Close** button at the very bottom; an "×" in the modal's top-right corner (like the one on the Getting Started tip) would be more discoverable.
- Everything else checks out: top toolbar fits with no collisions, left sidebar categories/items render cleanly with no clipped text, template cards have consistent heights and no truncated copy, compass and right-side viewport controls don't overlap anything.

**Recommended fix:** add a semi-transparent backdrop behind the modal (and/or raise the modal bottom margin so it clears the Lighting row), and move/hide FPS from the user-facing status bar.
